itens.trecho: They're no strangers, yet they've never met. Probably the most anticipated anime since the final film of Mr. Miyazaki. Because people know what these guys are capable of. This is one per cent sci-fi and 99 per cent fantasy. The concept is not new for us.

Your Name is a film that captivates its audience from beginning to end with its superb and incredibly unique storyline. The body swap genre is one that has been explored in various films, but the way it was intertwined with a love story in Your Name is brilliant. What sets this film apart is its refusal to hold the audience's hand.
I would never take it away from anyone, but I was underwhelmed. Final rating:★★ - Definitely not for me, but I sort of get the appeal.
